sonnet.problem: This story card says the whole speech is in Hebrew. That gives away the "in Hebrew" part of the correct answer to the later choice card 5 ("Calls out loudly in Hebrew"). The card also stretches verse 26 by saying the people on the wall "can hear every word of it."
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: This fill-in-the-blank asks the baker to supply a word from a quoted line ("this ___ will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria"). Nothing on the earlier cards lets the baker reason out "city" over "temple" or "palace." It is a guess at wording the baker hasn't seen.
sonnet.rule: The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
